license_basis: Pinned publisher README states source public-media clips under Creative Commons Attribution; no separate original-video license audit was performed. Original creator/title/URL attribution obtained from YouTube oEmbed.
dataset_credit: Typhoon team: Warit Sirichotedumrong, Adisai Na-Thalang, Potsawee Manakul, Pittawat Taveekitworachai, Sittipong Sripaisarnmongkol, Kunat Pipatanakul; Typhoon ASR Real-time technical report (2026), arXiv:2601.13044
naturalness_basis: Publisher describes in-the-wild human video speech, curated from public YouTube media and manually transcribed. These are complete existing dataset rows; no TTS, concatenation, truncation, resampling or reference rewriting performed here. This audit did not independently listen to or certify spontaneity of every clip.
selection: Four hand-selected rows from four source videos with English terms/phrases within Thai references. Small challenge subset; no claim of representative conversational code-switch coverage or random sampling.
download_method: Hugging Face rows API refreshes signed asset URLs; require cached-asset URL path contains exact revision, row ID and manual reference match, and downloaded WAV SHA256 matches this manifest. API does not expose a documented revision argument; if current cache points at a different revision, fail closed and use pinned Parquet explicitly.
